cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government contract carries terms on data jurisdiction, portability or exit. 10 to 20 per cent of public data was still held abroad in October 2026 (SEN-007).
cells.note: Law 2026-20, promulgated on 10 September 2026, requires state data to be hosted and processed in Senegal (SEN-018), beside the 2021 policy moving agencies' data to the Diamniadio national data centre (SEN-011), and agencies have moved data there since November 2023 (SEN-012), so stage 4. No contract with data terms is on file, so not 5.
